rollups.text: The user collects vintage postcards. On 2023-08-11, they reported adding 17 postcards since resuming collecting; three catalog entries were described: PC001, “1920s Paris Postcard” (1920s; acquired around 2023-06-11 at a local antique shop); PC002, “Vintage Beach Scene” (1950s; Colourpicture Publishers; acquired around 2023-07-11 on eBay); and PC003, “Eiffel Tower at Night” (1960s; acquired around 2023-06-11 at a local antique shop). On 2023-11-30, they acquired eight more postcards at a local antique shop, bringing the reported total added since resuming to 25. Exact acquisition dates for the first three cards were not provided.

The user’s exercise and sleep routine developed over time. On 2023-11-06, after reporting low daily steps and usually sleeping from around 11:00 p.m. to 6:30 a.m., they set a Fitbit reminder to go to bed by 10:30 p.m. and planned 30-minute morning walks or jogs, tracking activity in the Fitbit app. They identified consistency as a challenge and planned to schedule activity at the same time, treat missed days as recoverable, and vary routes or activities. On 2023-12-14, they reported waking at 6:30 a.m. every day, giving them extra time to exercise and get ready for work. Elapsed time from the initial plan to the reported daily wake-up routine: 38 days.

The user began a sourdough starter from scratch on 2023-10-18, feeding it daily and keeping it on the kitchen counter. On 2023-10-18, it looked okay but smelled only of flour and water, so the user asked whether that was normal. By 2023-10-21 to 2023-10-22, they planned to bake their first loaf and were practicing recipes and techniques, with interest in scoring a leaf or circle design. The planned first bake was three to four days after starting the starter; whether it was completed was not reported.

The user planned a charity fun run and partnership with a local children's hospital on 2023-10-11, drawing on participation in the 2022 “Run for the Kids” event and a 20-mile “Charity Cycle” fundraiser earlier in 2023. They intended to pitch the hospital, emphasize community benefits, remain open to feedback, and follow up on next steps. The plan was described on 2023-10-11; whether the pitch or event occurred was not reported.

The user has or cares for several houseplants, discussed on 2023-09-22: peace lily, snake plant (Sansevieria trifasciata), succulents, orchid, fern, African violets, and spider plant. The user reported the peace lily losing leaves after being brought home, used general-purpose fertilizer for the snake plant and succulents, considered orchid fertilizer, was considering a humidifier for the fern and African violets, noted African violet leaves get crispy in dry air, and was considering repotting the spider plant because its potting mix was old.

rollups.text: The user discussed these fishing activities and gear plans: around 2023-11-11 to 2023-11-12, they fished at Lake Tahoe with a friend; together they caught about a dozen trout, and the user caught a 3-pound trout using a silver lure. On 2023-12-01, the user said they were interested in fly fishing, had watched YouTube videos, and had ordered a beginner fly-fishing kit. They were also considering a lighter rod for smaller fish and considering entering a fishing tournament with a friend at Joe's Tackle on Main Street in January 2024; participation was not confirmed.

The user resumed collecting postcards and vintage camera equipment by 2023-08-11 and reported 17 new postcards. They began a catalog but found cataloging everything overwhelming and chose to stop after a short initial list, intending to add details later. On 2023-11-30, they reported eight more postcards, bringing the reported additions to 25, and planned to organize the cards by theme and begin displaying them on a simple postcard rack. They also expressed interest in space-saving displays, collector communities, and hosting a gathering to trade items and share knowledge. Elapsed time between the initial postcard report and the later update: 111 days.
